shortDescription: A Brazilian judge suspended part of new meal voucher rules for companies in a local lobby group, including Pluxee EURONEXT:PLX and Edenred's EURONEXT:EDEN Ticket, a court decision showed on Monday.

children: A Brazilian judge suspended part of new meal voucher rules for companies in a local lobby group, including Pluxee
Ticket, a court decision showed on Monday.
The judge suspended some parts of the rules, including a 3.6% regulatory cap on merchant discount rates, the decision showed
The judge granted an injunction to lobby group ABBT, saying the decision only benefits the companies that are part of the association
The main market leaders in the Brazilian meal voucher market - Alelo, Ticket, VR and Pluxee - are part of ABBT, according to the lobby group's website
The decision extends a judicial dispute between the Brazilian government and the sector over the new rules
The office of the Brazilian government's solicitor general did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the ruling
